name: memory_db_consolidation
description: Consolidate memory.db (memory_entries, daily_logs, memory_access_log, memory_buffer) and activity.db (activity_tasks) into icdev.db. Migrates existing rows from the standalone SQLite files into the main DB so all tools use get_connection() with no db_path overrides.
author: icdev-builder
notes: Safe to re-run (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + INSERT OR IGNORE). After applying, memory.db and activity.db are no longer used by any tool — they are kept as backups.
